Customer Acquisition.title: Fix underperforming paid acquisition channels
Customer Acquisition.whats_happening: Google Ads shows weaker conversion performance compared to other channels, indicating inefficient targeting.

what_you_should_do.how: Focus on high-intent queries and exclude low-performing audience segments

Customer Acquisition.title: Reduce bounce rate to improve acquisition efficiency
Customer Acquisition.whats_happening: Bounce rate is above optimal levels, causing loss of potential customers.

what_you_should_do.step: Improve landing page relevance and clarity
what_you_should_do.how: Align messaging with ads and simplify conversion steps

Customer Acquisition.title: Scale high-performing acquisition channels
Customer Acquisition.whats_happening: SMS and Email show strong efficiency compared to other channels.

what_you_should_do.step: Increase budget allocation to top-performing channels
what_you_should_do.how: Gradually scale spend while monitoring performance stability

Customer Acquisition.title: Fix non-performing email engagement
Customer Acquisition.whats_happening: Email engagement is extremely low, limiting acquisition potential.

Revenue Growth.title: Scale highest return channels
Revenue Growth.whats_happening: SMS delivers the highest return relative to spend.

what_you_should_do.how: Shift budget from lower-performing channels and monitor marginal returns

Revenue Growth.title: Eliminate inefficient spend
Revenue Growth.whats_happening: Some channels consume budget but underperform in revenue generation.

what_you_should_do.how: Continuously optimize budget allocation based on performance

Revenue Growth.title: Improve conversion funnel efficiency
Revenue Growth.whats_happening: Bounce rate indicates leakage in the conversion funnel.

what_you_should_do.how: Reduce friction and improve clarity of value proposition

Revenue Growth.title: Increase customer value through upselling
Revenue Growth.whats_happening: Revenue growth is limited by low average value per customer.

what_you_should_do.how: Promote higher-value packages and complementary products

Customer Retention.title: Strengthen post-purchase engagement
Customer Retention.whats_happening: Retention opportunities are underutilized after initial conversion.

what_you_should_do.how: Send reminders, offers, and personalized messages after purchase

Customer Retention.title: Reduce churn risk through re-engagement
Customer Retention.whats_happening: Some users disengage after initial interaction.

what_you_should_do.how: Target inactive users with incentives and reminders

Customer Retention.title: Leverage high-performing channels for retention
Customer Retention.whats_happening: SMS shows strong engagement potential for repeated interaction.

what_you_should_do.how: Send timely updates, offers, and reminders

Customer Satisfaction.title: Improve user experience on landing pages
Customer Satisfaction.whats_happening: Higher bounce rate suggests dissatisfaction with initial experience.

what_you_should_do.how: Simplify navigation and ensure consistency with ad messaging

Customer Satisfaction.title: Improve email experience and relevance
Customer Satisfaction.whats_happening: Email campaigns show no engagement, indicating poor user experience.

what_you_should_do.how: Use personalized and relevant messaging tailored to user needs

Customer Satisfaction.title: Collect customer feedback to identify pain points
Customer Satisfaction.whats_happening: Lack of direct customer feedback limits understanding of satisfaction drivers.
